Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int compareVersion(string v1, string v2) {
        if (v1 == v2) return 0;

        const int len1 = v1.size(), len2 = v2.size();
        int i = 0, j = 0;
        while (i < len1 || j < len2)
        {
            int num1 = 0; // 记录字符串v1中相邻两个dot字符间的数字(不包含首尾的点.字符)
            int num2 = 0; // 记录字符串v2中相邻两个dot字符间的数字
            while (i < len1 && v1[i] != '.')
            {
                int newDigit = v1[i++] - '0';
                num1 = num1 * 10 + newDigit;
            }
            while (j < len2 && v2[j] != '.')
            {
                int newDigit = v2[j++] - '0';
                num2 = num2 * 10 + newDigit;
            }
            if (num1 > num2) return 1;
            else if (num1 < num2) return -1;

            i++;
            j++;
        }
        return 0;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string version1 = "7.5.2.4", version2 = "7.5.3";
    auto res = sol.compareVersion(version1, version2);
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
